data.one_liner: Customer support, live chat, bug reporting, and feedback SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app customer support widget, live chat, bug reporting, feedback surveys, and network logging for Flutter applications. It connects user conversations with product development through integrations with Gleap.
use_when: You need an integrated live chat and customer support widget in your app.
Users need to report bugs with screenshots and automatic network logs.
avoid_when: You want a fully custom UI built from scratch for your support chat.
You are looking for an open-source self-hosted chat backend without third-party services.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and Web.
Built-in network logging integration for http and dio.
Secure customer identity support via JWT.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on iOS (Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods) and Android (minSdkVersion / manifest settings).
Tied to the proprietary Gleap backend and dashboard.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency, initializing with a Project ID, setting up iOS deployment target 15.0+, and optionally wrapping the app with GleapBannerArea for inline banners.
